notes.title: MORE FIXED SCHTUFF
notes.content:
• How to play dialogue box (people didn't know there was a clump button)
• Pause menu pauses game
• Exit dialogue boxes by selecting X available with controller

*A word from our Lord*
It has come to my attention that the Salty Sloth Studios has not made it abundantly clear on how to regroup my future friends. Press the A or Space buttons on your controller and keyboards. There is also a new dialogue box where I tell you this. This feature has been in the game from day one and we apologize for not making more clear. NOW GO GET ME SOME FRIENDS...PLZ!

*A word from us* 
We're very sorry Lord Cthulhu, please do NOT sacrifice us during the next ritual.
